activity.notes: Boris I ruled the First Bulgarian Empire from 852 to 889. He later took the Christian name Michael (Mihail); ATLAS preserves Boris I of Bulgaria as the canonical Person identity and treats 'Boris I Mikhail' as the same historical person.

sources.title: History — Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Bulgaria
sources.citation_text: The Bulgarian Ministry of Foreign Affairs dates the rule of knyaz Boris I Mihail to 852–889 and identifies the Christianization of Bulgaria in 864 during his reign.
